name: Russian Dip
steps: Support yourself atop a dip station with locked arms gripping the parallel bars and your core tightly braced.
Lower your body smoothly into the bottom of a dip, then shift your weight slightly back to rest both forearms flat along the parallel bars.
Shift your shoulders forward over your hands and press down to lift both forearms off the bars.
Finish extending your arms straight back to the top support position.
tips: Control the roll backward onto your forearms smoothly instead of crashing down onto your elbows.
Keep your elbows parallel along the bars rather than letting them flare wide.
